# Parthu Interiors (parthuinteriors.in)
> Premium turnkey residential interior design and execution firm in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

## Company Summary
Parthu Interiors is an end-to-end residential interior design and turnkey execution company based in Hyderabad. The firm takes complete responsibility from initial 3D design and advance space planning to factory-finished woodwork and final handover. With its own manufacturing facility in Kokapet and an Experience Center in Kukatpally, Parthu Interiors delivers bespoke 2BHK, 3BHK, Villa, and Penthouse interiors with a 45-day handover guarantee, transparent budgeting with zero hidden costs, and a 10-year structural warranty on 100% BWP (Boiling Water Proof) marine plywood.

## Key Facts
- **Brand Name:** Parthu Interiors
- **Domain:** https://parthuinteriors.in (also accessible at https://www.parthuinteriors.in)
- **Headquarters & Experience Center:** Kukatpally Housing Board Colony, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500072
- **Manufacturing Facility:** Kokapet, Hyderabad
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 87909 05746 (+91-8790905746)
- **Email:** parthuinteriors.hyderabad@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Sunday, 9:30 AM to 8:30 PM (Experience Center open till 7:30 PM)
- **Service Specialization:** Turnkey Residential Interiors (2BHK, 3BHK, Independent Houses & Luxury Villas)
- **Quality Standards:** 100% BWP Marine Plywood, Hafele & Blum German Hardware, Factory Precision Edge-Banding, 10-Year Warranty, 45-Day Delivery

## Primary Service Areas in Hyderabad
- West Hyderabad: Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, HITEC City, Kokapet, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Manikonda, Narsingi, Tellapur, Kollur, Puppalguda, Mokila
- Central & North Hyderabad: Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Kukatpally, Miyapur, Bachupally, Kompally, Secunderabad, Nizampet
- South & East Hyderabad: Attapur, Uppal, Nagole

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Complete Home Interiors:** End-to-end turnkey interior design and execution for new flats and villas.
- **Modular Kitchens:** Ergonomic L-shaped, U-shaped, parallel, and island modular kitchens with anti-scratch acrylic, PU, and soft-close German fittings.
- **Master & Guest Bedrooms:** Custom floor-to-ceiling wardrobes (sliding and openable), hydraulic storage beds, acoustic fluted wall paneling, and dressing units.
- **Living & Dining Suites:** TV entertainment consoles, bespoke partition screens, modern false ceilings with architectural COB/magnetic track lighting, and crockery cabinets.
- **Pooja Units & Mandirs:** CNC laser-cut jali work, back-lit onyx marble, and traditional wood finishes.
- **Home Renovation & Remodeling:** Civil modifications, electrical upgrades, premium repainting, and complete woodwork revamp.
